desc: Confirm the optimal structure (K smallest as tops, K largest as bottoms) and monotonicity for binary search.
Implement the full solution: read N and A, binary search max K with feasibility A[i]*2 <= A[N-K+i] for i=0..K-1, and print K.
Test the implementation on the three sample inputs and edge cases (N=2, K=0, K=N//2).
